Oilsand is another way to get heavy oil. Maybe you got lucky and found some in a mountainous biome. With your centrifuge you're able to get heavy oil and sand out of the ore. The veins can be found between Y 50-80.

Sadly, you can't use heavy oil until MV, so just stick them in a barrel or something until then.

[note]Until MV it can only be used for lubricant and burning in a semifluid generator.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: Personal Chunkloading
allNodesLists.data:
Let's craft a personal chunkloader. It will load a 3x3 chunk area. You need ender fragments, ender pearls, or coins to power the chunkloader.

Personal anchors can be powered with ender fragments for 1h, ender pearls for 4 hours, and a varying amount depending on the coin used.

Personal Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stays loaded while the player is logged in.

Passive Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stays loaded until the server resets.

World Anchors§r are always loaded, even after a server reset.

allNodesLists.name: Refinery Gas
allNodesLists.data:
Refine your gas in a chemical reactor with Hydrogen gas to give it a better burn value of 160,000 EU. It used to be the least useful fraction of oil, but it's now possible to distill it into large amounts of Ethylene if you steam-crack the Refinery Gas beforehand.

This early, you will have to use a Chemical Reactor to crack it, but later on there's a dedicated multiblock for this purpose, the Oil Cracker. For best Ethylene results, you should severely steam-crack it, and you will get lots of Methane as well.

After purification of your ore dust, you can centrifuge it to get even more byproducts out of the dust. On top of that, you can process many items into their more useful byproducts with this machine, such as Sticky Resin and Brick Dust.

It's always useful to check NEI for Centrifuge and Electrolyzer recipes for any item/fluid you may need. It might just be that you can get that from stuff you already have in your base!

[note]Use the checkbox if you rather use the steam multiblock.[/note]

Instead of a 3:2 ratio of ingots to plates, this machine allows for 1:1. This saves an enormous amount of metal, so make it ASAP.

allNodesLists.name: Scanning Bees, Crops and Moooooore!
allNodesLists.data:
Automate your bee, sapling, or crop scanning. For crops, this is the only real way to find the crop's stats until you can craft the Portable Scanner, which needs HV circuits that you can make in the next tier.

Later on, this machine gets very useful for scanning high tier machine parts for the assembly line research data or to fill data orbs with data for UUMatter production. Data sticks with raw prospecting data need a scanner too.

Do you need flawless or exquisite diamonds, emeralds, rubies or other gems? Or, interested in getting more flint, coal, or whatnot out of your ore? Well then it's time for you to make a Sifting Machine.

You can find small Zinc ores (look in NEI) or you can search the Nether for Sphalerite.

The Sifter only takes Purified ores, but you can get these easily by throwing Crushed ores into a Cauldron with water.

[note]Note that you need Polyethylene to make this machine![/note]

Too lazy to make an ore washer, yet bored with your non-automatable cauldron? Then the simple washer is the machine for you! It works much faster than a normal ore washer. Of course, you don't get any byproducts, but who cares!

There are simple washers for every tier up to UV, but the speed doesn't increase much past the HV version.

allNodesLists.name: Thermal Centrifuge
allNodesLists.data:
A machine to get different byproducts out of your crushed or purified ore dust. It's useful for getting a bit of Gallium out of crushed Zinc Ore for your Diodes needed in good circuits.

When you have IC2 nuclear reactors and want to recycle your depleted fuel rods, it's the only way to do so.

If you can't produce the 2A of LV power for this machine right now, wait until you get to MV and use transformers to power an LV version.

In LV, you can obtain the same ore byproducts via different methods. The Thermal Centrifuge only becomes really important in HV when you can combine it with the HV macerator.

[warn]Sending MV power to an LV device, even if it uses more than 1A will cause an explosion, so don't do that.[/warn]

allNodesLists.name: Throwing Out the Trash
allNodesLists.data:
Already have barrels full of cobblestone? The voiding drop filter can be setup to automatically void any item on pickup. Cobble, dirt, arrows, saplings, etc. It's handy for when you don't have much room for junk.

To use, rightclick the item filter you get as a reward. Put the things you want voided in the item filter list by clicking in there with them. Esc, then rightclick the voiding drop filter, and put the item filter inside.
allNodesLists.title: §5§lThrowing Out the Trash

allNodesLists.name: Time to Dry Out the Nether
allNodesLists.data:
Pumps can do more than pump oil and water. You can go to the nether and pump lava from the huge lava lakes too.

Once you reach HV, lava can be centrifuged for Silicon Dioxide, Magnesia, Quicklime, Gold, Sapphire, and Tantalite. You can get Silicon, Magnesium, Calcium, Gold, Aluminium, Manganese, Tantalum, and Oxygen out of them.

This is a good use for your LV pumps once you upgrade to MV pumps for oil. If you get into Thaumcraft or Blood Magic, there are ways to produce lava with magic unlimitedly and easily too.

[note]You'll want either ULV tanks and cells, or BC tanks and a dolly to transport your lava.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §5§lTime to Dry Out the Nether
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Time to Dry Out the Nether

Moving Your Tanks, Chests, and Barrels
Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?

allNodesLists.name: Too Much Fluid??
allNodesLists.data: Impossible! If you really think you have so much fluid that you want to just get rid of it, make a fluid trashcan. You can route as much excess creosote or whatever into it that you want.
allNodesLists.title: §5§lToo Much Fluid??

allNodesLists.name: Vroooooom...
allNodesLists.data:
Tired of standing around to collect all the drops and XP from your diamond spikes?

Make yourself a vacuum hopper to suck up all the drops and XP. Feed the XP into a tank to store it.
allNodesLists.title: §5§lVroooooom...

allNodesLists.name: Welcome to Tier 1, LV
allNodesLists.data:
Why, hello there! It seems you've made it into the electrical age. Don't be so quick to throw away your steam machines, you'll probably want to keep using them for a while.

To make your life easier, you'll want to focus on getting a wiremill and bender first... once you suffer through making all the machine components.

After that, the polarizer, assembler, lathe, and chemical reactor+fluid solidifier (for rubber) all help make things cheaper.

LV machines are more energy-efficient than their steam counterparts because steam machines convert Steam to Power with 50% efficiency, when the starting LV Steam Turbine has 85% efficiency.

ULV doesn't exist.
allNodesLists.title: §5§r§5§lWelcome to Tier 1, LV

allNodesLists.name: Where Does it All Go?
allNodesLists.data:
The time may come when you finally decide you have enough of a fluid. This overflow cover lets you tune how full a tank can get. You can put it on a smaller tank leading to a bigger tank, and when the bigger tank gets full, the fluid will backup into the smaller tank. Once the fluid level in the smaller tank exceeds the setting on the cover, it will start voiding fluid.

Handy for an oxygen centrifuge setup when you don't want to stop from excess nitrogen.
allNodesLists.title: §5§lWhere Does it All Go?
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Where Does it All Go?
Prequest requests:
Avengers, Assemble!

The first item you'll need a lot of. If you want to pull items out of chests or barrels you'll need one.

It works well with item pipes or GT machines, adjust with a screwdriver.

You can access the cover's interface with Shift+RMB.

allNodesLists.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #1

allNodesLists.data:
The fourth item you'll need a lot of, and is also a pain to craft. The most painful item you need to make lots of.

It works like a conveyor but can work with selected item slots, adjust with a screwdriver.

allNodesLists.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #4

allNodesLists.name: You're Gonna Hate This #2
allNodesLists.data:
The second item you'll need a lot of. When you want to get fluid out of tanks you'll need one.

Attach it to fluid pipes or GT machines/blocks. Adjust the flow direction and redstone behavior with a screwdriver. Place it on the side facing the tank or machine. When looking at a pipe or machine, you can use the grid to place it on a side already touching another thing. You can use the grid with a screwdriver to adjust a cover on that side as well.

When a GT pipe or machine has any cover, including a pump cover, wrenching the machine back into an item keeps the cover on that machine. The cover stays with the machine in the same direction when it is placed down again. This way you can arrange pump and conveyor covers on a machine outside a tight spot and place it there. To remove covers, use the crowbar.

It can also be further upgraded into a fluid regulator that allows precise control of fluid transfer speed.

You can acces covers interface with Shift+RMB.
allNodesLists.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #2
allNodesLists.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #2

Welcome to Tier 1, LV

allNodesLists.name: Your Magic Progression
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you're able to produce Aluminium, you may dig into magic. If you haven't unlocked basic thaumaturgy, try to find a Silverwood and a Greatwood sapling.

There is a coin quest that lets you purchase these saplings. If you haven't found any yet, go check it out!

allNodesLists.tooltip:
Your Magic Progression
Prequest requests:
Getting Ready for Tier 2, MV

allNodesLists.name: Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
allNodesLists.data:
Burning oil in the combustion generator is a very inefficient way of producing power. Every bucket/cell of oil only gives you 20,000 EU. Time to refine it.

You'll need to use a circuit to pick which of the products you want. Later on you can make a Distillation Tower to get all of them, but that's far away for now.

You can also distill many other fluids! There are two that are useful, but take a long time to distill, so you should set them up in advance:
Lubricant (from Creosote) and Distilled Water (from Water).
allNodesLists.title: §5§lYour Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!

Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allNodesLists.name: Acetic Acid
allNodesLists.data: Acetic acid can be made out of Oxygen and Ethylene. Alternatively, it can be made out of Biomass, Wood Vinegar or Vinegar. It is an important part of making Ethenone on your way to Cetane-Boosted Diesel.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAcetic Acid

allNodesLists.name: Advanced Centrifuge
allNodesLists.data: The MV centrifuge is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAdvanced Centrifuge

allNodesLists.name: Advanced Circuits
allNodesLists.data:
Finally, the HV circuit! To make it, you need good integrated circuits, RAM, an integrated logic circuit, and transistors.

By the way, circuits get cheaper to make as you go along, but not till HV.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAdvanced Circuits

allNodesLists.name: Advanced Compressor
allNodesLists.data: The MV compressor is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAdvanced Compressor

allNodesLists.name: Advanced Fluid Extractor
allNodesLists.data:
The MV fluid extractor is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.

To make bio diesel you need seed oil or fish oil. Seeds give seed oil and fish produce fish oil when placed in a fluid extractor.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAdvanced Fluid Extractor

allNodesLists.name: Advanced Macerator
allNodesLists.data: The MV macerator is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAdvanced Macerator

allNodesLists.name: All the Crops You Could Want
allNodesLists.data:
Tired of applying bonemeal or fertilizer by hand? A sprinkler can take water and boost your crop growth rate. Bonemeal or fertilizer will make it work even faster.

[note]Note that the sprinkler does not work with IC2 crops.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAll the Crops You Could Want
allNodesLists.tooltip:
All the Crops You Could Want

Come to the Dark Side...

allNodesLists.name: All Those Chunks, All in a Row
allNodesLists.data:
Sometimes you don't want a 3x3 area chunkloaded, but a long straight line instead. This can be handy for rail lines or power lines going across long distances. An anchor sentinel can perform this function. Right-click on a chunk loader with a crowbar, and it will activate. Go in any straight line from the chunkloader and place the anchor and hit it with the crowbar. Those chunks, up to 25x1, will now remain loaded.

This will draw an amount of chunkloader time relative to the 9 chunk area normally loaded. If for some reason you wanted only a 1 chunk area loaded, this will extend the time. Stock up on those pearls or server coins!
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAll Those Chunks, All in a Row
allNodesLists.tooltip:
All Those Chunks, All in a Row

Passive Chunkloading

allNodesLists.name: All We Are is Dust in the Wind
allNodesLists.data: Looking for an alternative to flowing water for your mobfarm? Use a fan to blow mobs or items where you want. Apply a redstone signal to activate.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAll We Are is Dust in the Wind
allNodesLists.tooltip:
All We Are is Dust in the Wind

MV Motor

allNodesLists.name: A New Alloy, Soularium
allNodesLists.data: There are some... "Darker" uses for machines. Stuff that might be considered "magic". Anyway, for that you need a new alloy: Soularium.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lA New Alloy, Soularium

allNodesLists.name: Are You Prepared For HV?
allNodesLists.data:
Stainless steel will be the tier material for HV. Use a MV mixer to produce the dust.

Manganese can be acquired as ore byproducts from spessartine, pyrolusite and tantalite ore. You can also pull them apart to get even more. Alternatively you can take apart Red Garnet dusts. If you get desperate, you can buy some ore from the Coins tab.

Chrome can be centrifuged out of ruby dust. You can get ruby dust from redstone if the ruby in redstone veins isn't enough.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lAre You Prepared For HV?
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Are You Prepared For HV?

Mixing at MV level

allNodesLists.name: A Soul Vessel
allNodesLists.data:
The Soul Vial is used later in HV Ender IO machines. For now though you may find it convenient to deal with....troublesome mobs. The Soul Vial is reuseable. Just right-click any living entity to steal its soul. Right click again to release it in the environment.

The possibilities swirl in your head...

allNodesLists.tooltip:
A Soul Vessel

allNodesLists.data: The MV miner will find ores for you faster than the LV miner, and in a larger range. It also has a larger fortune bonus, great for gathering small ores in the Nether. Plus it's faster, but I'm sure you figured that.

Auto Mining MV

allNodesLists.data: Plant mass needs to be centrifuged into bio chaff, the base material to make biomass.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lBio Chaff

allNodesLists.name: Bio Diesel Fuel
allNodesLists.data: With ethanol or methanol and seed oil or fish oil you can make bio diesel. It's burn value is 256,000 EU per cell, less than regular diesel, but more renewable. Diesel or bio diesel are needed for cetane-boosted diesel.

allNodesLists.name: Bio Fuels
allNodesLists.data:
You've been using steam, creosote, and possibly oil plus their byproducts to generate power. It's time to start making bio diesel. The first step is to make plant balls out of organic materials. You can use wheat, sugarcane, apples, saplings or, well, practially anything. Indigo blossoms are 4:1 and unlike the rest of the IC2 crops with the same ratio, not really useful for anything else. Realistically, you'll probably just use saplings though, since you'll want/need a tree farm anyway.

Be sure you have a Forestry multifarm, Steve's Carts Farm, IC2 Crop Sticks with a harvester, or whatever, because you need plenty of biomaterials for constant bio diesel production.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lBio Fuels

allNodesLists.name: Biomass
allNodesLists.data:
Chose the IC2 or the gregtech way to make biomass. Water and Bio Chaff is needed.

You can also use the pyrolyze oven to make biomass in a more efficient way if you make it.

Note that forestry has it's own biomass as well. It can also be made into fermented biomass like this kind. Choose which kind you want to make later on yourself.
allNodesLists.title: §5§6§lBiomass
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Biomass
Prequest requests:
Way One: IC2 Fluid Canner
Way Three: Pyrolyse Oven
Way Two: Brewery

allNodesLists.name: Bio Organic Mesh
allNodesLists.data:
If you want to save the environment you can autoclave 16 plantballs to get raw bio fiber with the following liquids:

Biomass 33% chance
Methanol 50% chance
Fuel 90% chance
Nitro-diesel 100% chance

§rHowever, making carbon plates this way will require an electric blast furnace.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lBio Organic Mesh

allNodesLists.name: Borax Electrolyzing
allNodesLists.data: Now that you have an MV Electrolyzer, you can extract Boron from Borax. This element is used later on for Borosilicate Glass and fiber, but for now you can use it to make some volumetric flasks to hold precise amounts. This is handy for recipes that may only need a tiny amount of a substance, like 1L.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lBorax Electrolyzing

allNodesLists.name: Brewing Liquids
allNodesLists.data:
This machine is not only capable of brewing more powerful burnable liquids, it can also be used to brew nutrient distillation, which might have further usage soon™.

Note that you get different ratios depending on what item you use for recipes that allow alternates. Use what you like.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lBrewing Liquids

allNodesLists.name: Caging a Demon - Wither Killing Chamber
allNodesLists.data:
Ever wanted to trap a wither but the only option was non movable bedrock? Now that you've made dark steel you can get reinforced obsidian which is wither-proof. Useful for manual killing and even automation once you get a powered spawner supplying you with wither skeleton skulls.

[note]Hint: Unlike vanilla obsidian, reinforced obsidian CAN be moved by pistons which might come in handy.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lCaging a Demon - Wither Killing Chamber
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Caging a Demon - Wither Killing Chamber

Come to the Dark Side...

allNodesLists.data: Carbon plates are used for a bunch of stuff, including eventually the nanosuit. Go check out the armor chapter.

allNodesLists.data:
Dehydrate your grapes to raisins. Or make some Styrene, Benzene or Ethylene at MV. Either way, this device is a nice to have.

It also does the Drying Rack recipes as well.

allNodesLists.data: More advanced recipes need an MV chemical reactor. It also speeds up your existing recipes.

allNodesLists.name: Clay Electrolyzing
allNodesLists.data:
If you looked through NEI you may have found out that electrolyzing clay dust will give you Alumina, Silicon Dioxide, Sodium, and Lithium dust. And water, but you're probably just voiding that already, right? There's plenty of stained clay blocks found in canyon, mesa, lush desert biomes or several to a couple dozen on mountains that can be pulverized to clay dust.

There's more ways to get alumina now that you're in MV, enough that it's basically worthless by the time you get to EV.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lClay Electrolyzing

allNodesLists.data: ...we have cookies.

allNodesLists.data:
Probably the most awesome way to transport just about anything in multiple different ways. Get some conduits of each type. Higher tiers of each (except item) exist.

[note]There's also ME conduits for when you can do that.[/note]

allNodesLists.data:
Make your first coolant out of water or distilled water and lapis dust in an mv mixer.

Using distilled water lets you save on lapis while also speeding up the process by a lot.

[note]If you don't use distilled water, you will need a lot more than 8 lapis dust.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lCoolant

allNodesLists.name: Cooling Kanthal
allNodesLists.data: Hot Kanthal ingots can be cooled down in an MV Chemical Bath.

Cooling Kanthal

allNodesLists.name: Cough Cough - Something Needs to Be Done About the Smell
allNodesLists.data:
Birds falling out of the sky, fish dead and floating belly up in the rivers, acid rain melting the ground...Time to start picking up the trash and cleaning up the air. Small black steel turbines should be fine for now. You'll need two amps of steady power to keep the scrubber working.

The detector's setting can be changed by clicking on the +/- texture with a screwdriver. Also, in general, better (and larger) turbines work better at cleaning up pollution. The code is too complex to fully explain here, but that's basically it. More EU turbine = more pollution cleaning turbine.

[warn]This quest covers one method of combating pollution - there are others, including not making as much to begin with.[/warn]

Cough Cough - Something Needs to Be Done About the Smell

Stainless Taking Too Long?

allNodesLists.data:
After embracing the dark side you get access to the new even bigger dark steel chest... perhaps another upgrade will be available in the future?

[note]Just as with the previous chests you can also upgrade with a fitting upgrade item.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §5§6§lDark Steel Chest
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Dark Steel Chest

Diamond Chests... Ooo, Shiny
Come to the Dark Side...

allNodesLists.name: Dark Steel Pipes
allNodesLists.data:
Dark steel pipes are much better than the bronze, steel, or potin pipes you might have been using. Make sure your wrench can handle mining level 3 or you can't deconstruct them.

[note]If you don't need these, just recycle them to get the materials back. Not everything needs ginormous pipes or high heat tolerance.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §5§6§lDark Steel Pipes
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Dark Steel Pipes
Prequest requests:
Come to the Dark Side...

allNodesLists.name: Dark Steel Tools
allNodesLists.data:
There are also tools made of dark steel. Each of them can receive upgrades. Hold shift to get the tooltip which will explain what you need in order to upgrade them.

These tools can also be enchanted like vanilla tools.

The Ender will increase wither skull and ender pearl drops. It can be upgraded to teleport the player.

Dark shears can be empowered, and then will shear a large area, including leaves. Handy for clearing away that giant redwood! Maybe you will find other uses for it.

The axe, once empowered, can be recharged wirelessly while in farming station.

The pick? Well, it can mine cobalt I guess if you haven't gotten a tool capable of that yet. You could keep it around to use for base decorations if your normal pick is too fast, I suppose.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lDark Steel Tools
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Dark Steel Tools
Prequest requests:
Come to the Dark Side...

allNodesLists.name: Did You Run Low On Gold or Redstone?
allNodesLists.data:
Did you run low on redstone and/or gold? It's no problem with a glowstone flower farm. You can centrifuge glowstone dust to redstone and gold dust. Redstone is also a good source of chrome. You'll need tons of gold for HV, so it's a good idea to set this up before then.

[note]There's actually a couple plants that produce glowstone, pick the one you like![/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lDid You Run Low On Gold or Redstone?
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Did You Run Low On Gold or Redstone?

Advanced Centrifuge

allNodesLists.data: If you get an MV mixer, you can mix your light and heavy fuel together to give diesel. At 480,000 per cell, this turns 1,525,000 EU into 2,880,000, not accounting for how much you spent to get it, so it's definitely worth it.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lDiesel Fuel
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Diesel Fuel

Light Fuel
Heavy Fuel

allNodesLists.name: Do You Feel Unlucky?
allNodesLists.data:
Well not any more! With some emeralds and a blank book, I'll give you a Fortune I book you can use in your printing press. Once you've duplicated it, you can combine the 2 Fortune I books in an anvil to get a Fortune II. Duplicate the Fortune II books to get a Fortune III!

With a Fortune III book and a tier-specific item you can remove the trash item rewards from your loot bags. More good stuff!

Soulbound is another good enchantment, it will keep an enchanted item in your inventory in case of death.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lDo You Feel Unlucky?
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Do You Feel Unlucky?
Prequest requests:
Gut-Enough For You? Bet You Thought Newspapers Were Dead!

allNodesLists.name: Electrolyzing All the Things
allNodesLists.data:
Collected a lot of dusts you can't do anything with since you started with macerating, washing and centrifuging ores? It's finally time to get all the useful materials out of them.

This machine is §overy §o§rimportant for your MV progression. If you find a biome with tons of Stained or Hardened Clay, you can process it here, plus some other machines, into Sodium, Lithium, Silicon, Aluminium and Oxygen!
allNodesLists.title: §6§lElectrolyzing All the Things

allNodesLists.name: Empty Plastic Board
allNodesLists.data:
Plastic circuit boards require a plastic plate with Sulfuric Acid to make an Empty Board. By adding copper foil and Iron(III) Chloride or Sodium Persulfate you can craft a plastic circuit board. Later on you can make them more efficiently.

[note]PCBs are used in the circuits in HV tier.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lEmpty Plastic Board

allNodesLists.name: Ethanol
allNodesLists.data: Ethanol has a burn value of 192,000 EU per cell can be used to make bio diesel and other fluids.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lEthanol

allNodesLists.name: Ethenone
allNodesLists.data:
Hopefully you saved some sulfuric acid. If not, make some more. Together with acetic acid you can make ethenone.

Save the ethenone for HV, you'll need it to make tetranitromethane for cetane boosted diesel.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lEthenone

allNodesLists.name: Ethylene
allNodesLists.data:
You can make ethylene several different ways

- Ethanol and sulfuric acid in a Chemical Reactor
- Ethanol in a Chemical Dehydrator
- Distilling various gases (i.e. wood gas) in a Distillery
- Obtain it from Oil in the Working with Oil tab

[note]You will need much more than 4 cells later on so keep that in mind.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lEthylene

allNodesLists.name: Even Rarer Earths
allNodesLists.data:
Rare Earth processing may have been ignored, but you believe your new Dehydrator can finally make it worthwhile. First, you need to use some Sulfuric Acid to melt off any impurities in a Chemical Bath, leaving you with Crushed Rare Earth (I). After that you need to process it like a normal ore until you get Rare Earth (I) Dust.

After running the Dust through your Dehydrator, you get a number of strange materials, only some of which you recognize. But if you run these materials through an Electrolyzer or through the Dehydrator again, you may get some use out of them. Some of them may take quite a few to do so, but you §o§o§r§h§ohave§r been stockpiling, right? You'll need 204 Rare Earth.

You believe if you had more powerful acids and machines, you could extract even more valuable materials out of the Rare Earth.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lEven Rarer Earths

allNodesLists.name: Extrude All the Things
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you've hit MV tier, it's time to get a better ratio when making rods, pipes, wires, plates and many more parts. Most extruder recipes use more than 32 EU/t so you need an MV extruder. After crafting the machine you need extruder shapes for the different types of parts you will want to make.

There are a few more shapes than the ones listed here. Make sure to have a look.

[note]Most of the Tinkers Gregworks tool parts are made in the extruder. They also have long extrusion times to balance out their usefulness.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lExtrude All the Things
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Extrude All the Things

allNodesLists.name: Fermented Biomass
allNodesLists.data: Fermenting your biomass allows you to to get more products out of it like methanol, ethanol, ammonia, etc.

allNodesLists.name: Firestone Ore/Dust
allNodesLists.data:
Firestone ore is used to make some BC machines like the filler, and some other stuff. Unforunately, it's in the nether...at the bottom of the lava ocean!

Here are some tips for finding it:

-Firestone only spawns in deep lava, at least 6 deep. It will only replace netherrack, so a fjord filled with soulsand won't have any. Can you think of ways to check the lava depth, and what's down there?
-Alternatively, if you keep your head at just the correct height above the lava and at the correct angle, you'll be able to see underneath it - surely there must be a hovering jetpack?
-...or just look for the biome when your cursor is over the JM map. Hell is the default one that has netherrack.

Firestone can be mined with the GT miners, if you place it within horizontal range. Firestone ore and products will cause random fires to start nearby, so get it into a backpack quickly!
allNodesLists.title: §6§lFirestone Ore/Dust

allNodesLists.name: Glycerol
allNodesLists.data:
Glycerol is a byproduct of making bio diesel, but it's really useful too. It's used to make epoxid in EV, and for making dynamite, I guess. both TNT and iTNT are better though.

allNodesLists.data: By the way, did you ever try looking at the oredict for circuits? You can tell what tier they are from that. They go: Primitive (ULV), Basic (LV), Good (MV), Advanced (HV), etc. Now make your Good Integrated Circuits.

allNodesLists.data: While the SAG mill will work with no grinding heads, flint heads only save a little power. If you want to exploit the true capability of the SAG mill, you want to use Diamond or Tungsten grinding heads. Craft me a Diamond head and I'll give you a Tungsten one as a reward.

allNodesLists.name: Gut-Enough For You? Bet You Thought Newspapers Were Dead!
allNodesLists.data:
The Typesetting Table and Printing Press will allow you to duplicate books, including enchanted books. The process is kinda complicated, so check out the Bibliocraft mod wiki page. You'll need to use XP to duplicate enchanted books, so now would be a good time to figure out how to collect large amounts...

To duplicate a Fortune III book you may need 40+ levels. Note that the wiki mentions black dye but only vanilla ink sacs will work.

[note]You'll need some Thaumium ingots. You can get into Thaumcraft, find some in a chest, or try breeding the Magic Metal Berry IC2 crop.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: Making Things Pretty
allNodesLists.data:
While conduits on their own are already awesome, you can also hide them if you want. There are 2 types of facades, basic and hardened. While basic ones are simple and easy, the reinforced ones are able to withstand explosions and mining with tools. You have to use your Yeta Wrench to remove it.

You'll have to paint your facades in the Painting Machine first - place the block you want them to look like where the paintbrush is, and the facade on the left. Of course, the Painting Machine needs to be powered.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lMaking Things Pretty

allNodesLists.name: Methane Gas
allNodesLists.data: Methane gas has a burn value of 104,000 EU per cell and can be burned in the gas turbine.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lMethane Gas

allNodesLists.name: Methanol
allNodesLists.data: Methanol has a burn value of 84,000 EU per cell and can be used to make bio diesel and other fluids. It's also used to make certain rocket fuels.

allNodesLists.data: MV Mixer is needed to progress toward HV. It also unlocks Diesel, more efficient fuel.

allNodesLists.name: Molten Plastic
allNodesLists.data: Molten polyethylene can be made in a chemical reactor using ethylene, compressed air cells or oxygen - using oxygen gives a 50% boost. Use a mold for making plates in a fluid solidifier to make plastic sheets.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lMolten Plastic

allNodesLists.name: Molten Polyethylene
allNodesLists.data:
Polyethylene is made out of ethylene and oxygen in a chemical reactor. Molten Polyethylene cells hold 144L, perfect for 1 ingot or plate.
If you want precise amounts, you can use a Volumetric Flask once you electrolyze some Boron from Borax.

You §omay§r have started getting damaged from holding the cells. If you have, put your glove baubles back on. All Molten cells cause damage and store 144L. Mostly, Molten cells come from metal-type materials, or stuff that was melted. Excuse me, §oFluid Extracted§r, whatever that's supposed to mean.

Notice some leftovers? Try using the plunger, or if you have the materials, you can use 12 ethylene cells and 84 oxygen cells to make exactly 125 cells of polyethylene.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lMolten Polyethylene

allNodesLists.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Boules
allNodesLists.data: To make wafers, you need to make monocrystalline silicon boules first. The process takes 450 seconds and requires solar grade silicon dust and a small gallium arsenide crystal in the electric blast furnace. You can make 16 wafers out of every boule.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lMonocrystalline Silicon Boules

allNodesLists.name: MV Superconductors (128 EU/t)
allNodesLists.data:
How about lossless 128 EU Wires? Pentacadmiummagnesiumhexaoxide is a superconductor wire and will transfer your energy without any loss. Every Voltage going forward has a superconductor wire with zero loss.

Mix Cadmium, Magnesium and Oxygen in an MV mixer. Next, the base dust needs an EBF with Kanthal Coils to be smelted. A vacuum freezer is also required to cool it down. Make some MV Superconductor Base Wires and use an Assembler to combine these wires with Helium, Stainless Steel pipes and MV pumps to get your 128 eu/t superconductor wires.

[note]Whether these are worth it to save a little power or not is up to you of course. Also note that although they're wires, you aren't hurt by coming into contact with them.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: O like Oxygen
allNodesLists.data:
Oxygen can be made in lots of different ways. Most commonly you'll either electrolyze it out of cassiterite sand, sugar from sugar canes or sugar beets, water, or various other oxygen-rich dusts, or centrifuge it from brown or yellow limonite dust.

Later on, water electrolyzing or air centrifuging is probably going to be your main source.

allNodesLists.tooltip:
O like Oxygen

Electrolyzing All the Things

allNodesLists.name: One in a Million
allNodesLists.data: Or 4? Need to store ludicrous amounts of cobble? Stone dust? Saplings? Super chests are the thing to use. A Super Chest I can store 4 million items, worry free. You will need to take items out manually 64 at a time, or use conveyors etc to extract them.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lOne in a Million

allNodesLists.name: Ore Processing, Kind Of...
allNodesLists.data:
The endless war between macerators and SAG mills rages on eternally, so why does it matter which one you choose?

HV Macerators are still required for the final byproducts on many ore chains, but a SAG mill still shines through with upgraded grinding heads! SAG mills are perfect machine for getting the most from your ores without using bees and crops. You can get bonus outputs with tungsten grinding heads, but that doesn't mean you can dupe materials (like ingots) with it. Plus for many of them you'll get the final output directly without any need for further processing. Handy for processing Redstone to get Chrome!

It's great for lead, copper, tin, silver, nickel, redstone, ruby, lapis, certus quartz, and malachite ores. Other ores will give you better outputs as well if you use a good enough head.

Even coal, charcoal, bones, wheat, ender pearls, and charcoal non-ores will give bonus outputs.

That said, the GT ones are still way faster later on.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lOre Processing, Kind Of...

allNodesLists.name: Organic Way
allNodesLists.data: Bio carbon plates are made out of raw carbon mesh. Put it in the electric blast furnace to make carbon plates.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lOrganic Way

allNodesLists.name: Passive Chunkloading
allNodesLists.data:
Using the MV bender you can finally press dense plates. So let's craft a passive chunkloader. It will also load a 3x3 chunk area. You need ender pearls or coins to power the chunkloader.

Passive anchors will run for 1 hour off of an ender pearl, and a varying amount depending on the coin used.

§aPersonal Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stay loaded while the player is logged in.

§9Passive Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stay loaded until the server resets.

[warn]World Anchors[/warn] are always loaded, even after a server reset.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPassive Chunkloading

allNodesLists.name: Pipes, Pipes Everywhere
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you're in MV, you'll want to start automating processes. Polyethylene, Oxygen, Nitrogen, Hydrogen, Rubber, Charcoal, etc. Faster item pipes will help with transporting items quicker around your base. For now, use your spiffy new extruder to craft some brass item pipes.

The reward - restrictive item pipes - allow you to prioritize destinations. Locations on the other side of a restrictive pipe are treated as much further away than locations on the same side of a pipe. Very handy when you want overflow (or non-matching) items to go somewhere else!

For higher tiers, look up "* item pipe" in NEI, or just look at the spreadsheet.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPipes, Pipes Everywhere
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Pipes, Pipes Everywhere
Prequest requests:
Extrude All the Things

allNodesLists.name: Plantballs
allNodesLists.data:
Next you should compress plantballs out of your wheat.

The MV compressor is twice as fast as the LV. You might think this means using it is a good idea. Well, it depends. Remember it also uses 4x the power. This means you spend 2x the EU in total to get the same amount of EU out. If you overclock to much in your fuel production setup, you end up with an EU deficit! Overclocking once is usually well worth it though.

Eventually you want to use multiblocks for better speeds and efficiency!
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPlantballs

allNodesLists.name: Plant Mass
allNodesLists.data: Macerate the plantballs down to plant mass for better processing. The HV macerator has an extra slot so you can get more, but it's not worth it power-wise, same for EV and IV.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPlant Mass

allNodesLists.name: Polyvinyl Chloride
allNodesLists.data:
Polyvinyl Chloride is PVC which can be used for the PVC Pipes. You need Vinyl Chloride and Oxygen to make it. You'll also want it for SMD capacitors later.

Do the recipe twice if you want to clean out your reactor, or three times if used the eight second recipe.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPolyvinyl Chloride

allNodesLists.name: Portable Prospecting Tool
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you have some tech, you've discovered a way to prospect for ores.

Unfortunately, the tech to make it repairable or rechargeable doesn't work, so you'll have to make a new one each time it breaks. It does work better at higher tiers and lasts longer with better materials.

It doesn't make a convenient book like the Seismic Prospector, but you can look at the results of scanning on the map, thanks to Visual Prospecting.

It can be hard to choose a good material for the Basic Prospector. Here are some good choices for you in their respective tiers, the size searched, and the average amount of veins they can scan:

LV Vanadiumsteel 3x3 - 50
MV Vanadiumsteel 3x3 - 213
HV Vibrant Alloy 5x5 - 299
EV Shadow Metal 7x7 - 1080
IV Oriharukon 7x7 - 2649

As you can see, the prospectors become better and better with each tier, but it might also be worth looking around for better materials.

Good luck.
allNodesLists.title: §5§6§lPortable Prospecting Tool
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Portable Prospecting Tool
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This in MV Too #6

allNodesLists.name: Portable Tanks
allNodesLists.data:
Until now, you had to use buildcraft tanks with dollies to carry liquids around. Which can be a pain with all that slowness. These portable tanks from EnderIO are able to push and pull liquids by themselves, as they have a built-in pump which is powered by some magic energy source. How convenient.

The pressurized versions are twice as large.

[note]Just be careful, because it will eat water cells instead of returning them.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPortable Tanks

allNodesLists.name: Power of the Sun
allNodesLists.data:
Now it's time to invest in some renewable energy. Let's start with solar panels. The basic one only gives 1 EU/t. Most GT machines can use them as covers, and receive power, but only so long as it can see the sun (the top). Be sure to put a glass layer above them in case it rains while you swap panels. You'll still want to keep rain off the sides of the machine hull too.

[note]The Aluminium Iron plate needs an MV Forming Press.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPower of the Sun

allNodesLists.name: Power of the Sun 1x1
allNodesLists.data: Put those single EU panels on a block to make them placeable in the world. Use an MV assembler to combine the panel with a ULV hull.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPower of the Sun 1x1
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Power of the Sun 1x1

Power of the Sun

allNodesLists.data: The next solar panel you can make is the ULV one. It generates 8 EU/t.

Power of the Sun ULV

Power of the Sun

allNodesLists.data: With the MV forming press you can make aluminum iron plates for solar panels, turbine blades for turbines and some items for Logistics Pipes.

allNodesLists.name: PVC Sheets
allNodesLists.data: PVC Sheets make SMDs (make foils), plastic circuit boards, and really good item pipes.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lPVC Sheets

allNodesLists.name: Raw Carbon Mesh
allNodesLists.data: This way of making carbon plates requires autoclaving carbon dust. There are 4 different fluids you can use, check NEI to see which gives how much.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lRaw Carbon Mesh

allNodesLists.name: Raw Silicon Dust
allNodesLists.data:
Silicon is needed in all boule (and thus wafers, chips, and circuits) creation. Silicon is therefore an §oincredibly important material§r.

With your new Electrolyzer you can obtain Raw Silicon Dust from many different sources. Alternatively, you can also centrifuge Redstone. You can also get it from Silicon Dioxide, by adding Magnesium Dust to it in a Chemical Reactor and then recycling it in an Electrolyzer, which also gives you a lot of bonus Oxygen.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lRaw Silicon Dust
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Raw Silicon Dust
Prequest requests:
Silicon Dioxide
Electrolyzing All the Things

allNodesLists.name: RF Batteries
allNodesLists.data:
Basic Capacitor Banks are RF batteries which can store the RF power you generate. You can put many blocks together to enlarge your total battery capacity - they will merge into one battery.

You can also change the mode of each face using your wire cutters or yeta wrench instead of the GUI. One option is a nice display of input and output RF, but it has to be taller than it is wide.

These are great for interfacing with RF machines. GT wires will convert to RF, but they send a full amp packet no matter what. EnderIO machines properly accept it, but others like Genetics do not and waste most of the packet, so consider using them with any RF machine if it looks like you need it.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lRF Batteries

allNodesLists.name: Ruby Electrolyzing
allNodesLists.data:
Ruby is a good source for chrome and a little alumina. Once you get low on Ruby, you can centrifuge Redstone to get more.

Another good source of alumina and oxygen is red granite dusts. You can get those from red stonelillies. Check out the Fishing Farming Cooking tab for more details about IC2 crops.
allNodesLists.title: §6§f§6§lRuby Electrolyzing

allNodesLists.name: Salty from all the silicon?
allNodesLists.data:
If you are salty about the ingredients needed to purify silicon, I got good news for you! You can recover all of the chlorine and sodium you used by electrolyzing the salt you got!

[note]You can also use zinc instead of sodium, the first reaction is longer but the recycling is much cheaper.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSalty from all the silicon?
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Salty from all the silicon?
Prequest requests:
Silicon Tetrachloride - continued

allNodesLists.name: Seed Oil
allNodesLists.data: Pam's peanuts are a good seed oil source, and can be sped up with sprinklers. Or you can use IC2 crops to get Rapeseed. Another option is Forestry tree nuts such as Hazelnuts, Butternuts, or the King of nuts, coconuts. Or you can be lame and get them from regular seeds like wheat seeds.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSeed Oil

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Dioxide
allNodesLists.data:
Get yourself some Silicon Dioxide! Smelting it in your EBF with some carbon is the best way to obtain raw silicon ingots. It is used it a few places but most importantly you can macerate it back down to raw silicon dust. You can also turn the silicon dioxide into raw silicon dust via chemical processes using aluminium or magnesium.

You can get silicon dioxide easily by centrifuging glass dust or electrolyzing sand.

If you have raw silicon dust but want silicon dioxide for some reason, you can use an arc furnace or an autoclave.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Dioxide

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Plate
allNodesLists.data: Advanced circuits require transistors, which are made out of high grade silicon plates, fine tin wire and molten polyethylene.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Plate

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Solar Grade
allNodesLists.data: Whichever path you followed, you now have the Solar Grade Silicon Dust. You want to smelt it into ingots to make plates for Transistors, but you will also need some to make Silicon Boules.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Solar Grade
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Silicon Solar Grade
Prequest requests:
Trichlorosilane - continued
Silicon Tetrachloride - continued

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Tetrachloride
allNodesLists.data: However, the raw silicon dust you obtained is not pure enough! We will need to work on that. There are two reasonable options to do so. Let us look at the first one here. Don't worry, this is just a simple two step process. First let us start by reacting it with some chlorine in a chemical reactor.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Tetrachloride

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Tetrachloride - continued
allNodesLists.data:
As a second step, we combine the Tetrachloride with Sodium Dust. There we go! The Silicon Dust is now purified to solar grade!

The Chlorine and Sodium are §onot§r lost during this process. To recover them, just electrolyze the Salt you get at the end and send it back to the Chemical Reactors, for a complete loop that turns Raw Silicon into Solar Grade Silicon.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Tetrachloride - continued

allNodesLists.name: Silicon Wafer
allNodesLists.data:
To create some silicon wafers, put the monocrystalline silicon boule in a cutting machine. It would be best to make the MV version because you'll need it soon for ILCs, RAM, and other chips.

You can also use wafers to make diodes more efficiently if you have polyethylene as well.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSilicon Wafer

allNodesLists.name: Simple Fluid Transfer
allNodesLists.data: Just like the item translocators, the fluid ones transfer... fluids. Same restrictions apply, 1 block distance. These can also be upgraded.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSimple Fluid Transfer

allNodesLists.name: Simple Item Transfer
allNodesLists.data: Translocators can only transfer items over a distance of 1 block. But they're quite cheap, and a good solution to building compact machine setups. They include a free simple item filter which can be enabled on the input or output side. And they support multiple inputs and outputs! Glowstone will make it transfer faster - try investigating other upgrades.
allNodesLists.title: §6§lSimple Item Transfer

allNodesLists.name: Simple RF Power: Liquids
allNodesLists.data:

Fuel Burn Time (ticks/mb) Power Output (RF/tick) Power Output (RF/mb)
Oil 5 30 150
Hootch 6 60 360
Ethanol 15 40 600
Fire Water 15 80 1200
Diesel/Fuel 25 60 1500

[note]Rocket Fuel is disabled.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: Simple RF power: Solid
allNodesLists.data:
By simply burning coal as fuel, this machine produces RF power. Enough for a basic machine setup. This machine will also accept compressed and multiple-compressed blocks. Want to burn something for 250+ days? Also, with double or octadic capacitors the output will increase and efficiency will improve.

GT wiring can convert EU to RF, but not the other way around. Note that with the eNet changes a GT wire network will need at least one GT energy consumer - a machine hull of the matching voltage will work.

Ender IO machines and GT cables and Wires can be left safely out in the rain.

It might be useful for Genetics machines since they consume excessive power when attached to GT wiring - Forestry and EnderIO machines work fine (except for the Thermionic Fabricator). Or use a Capacitor Bank.

allNodesLists.name: Speeding Up Slow Machines
allNodesLists.data:
Many mods don't have methods of speeding up their slow machines. For this, you'll need a GregTech World Accelerator. It guzzles amps though, so your power infrastructure better be ready for it. The tooltip will list the performance boost provided. For block-based acceleration, the WA will do an area around it. For TileEntities like most machines, it will only accelerate the blocks directly touching the WA, and will need to be reconfigured with a screwdriver. This uses twice the power though.

[warn]This does not work with GregTech machines![/warn] For those, build more or higher tier ones.

If you want, you can change the level of acceleration by using a wrench on it. It will go back to the minimum, then increase one tier from there for every usage. It will use that tier's amount of power (and acceleration), increasing as per GT standard of 2x speed (acceleration) and 4x EU per tier.

It takes 85 seconds at 480 EU/t or 60 seconds at 480 EU/t by adding Oxygen gas. Always add a gas if you can, you're saving tons of power by doing so, and you're gonna need a TON of SS. The Cracker, Large Steam Turbine, and Distillery Tower all need huge amounts of SS. A single DT uses several stacks, and you're gonna want more than just one.

allNodesLists.name: Stainless Taking Too Long?
allNodesLists.data:
Time for a second EBF!

You can make ingots faster in 3 ways - better coils, higher tier energy hatches, or adding more furnaces. It's probably time to add a second EBF to your base.

Multiblock machines can share casings, mufflers, and input/output hatches/busses, but not maintenance hatches (you can share the auto ones though). You can share energy hatches, but only if you can supply enough power to all machines it's a part of.

Remember, pollution will be very high with two EBFs active at once! Watch out for high pollution effects. Use the best mufflers available and don't place the EBFs in the same chunk as farmland or other high pollution machines like Pyrolyse Ovens and Large Boilers. Maybe it is time to do something more active?

You can use whatever coils you have lying around, but you certainly want to start searching for Mica if you haven't found any yet.

allNodesLists.name: Welcome to the Church of Benzene
allNodesLists.data:
If you made it to MV using steam, you're probably wondering how to survive going further. One option is to switch to Light Fuel, discussed in LV. Another option is to use Benzene. Benzene is made from Wood Tar. There are a couple of pathways for that. Both start with logs from trees.

One path is to use Coke Ovens or Advanced Coke Ovens to make charcoal, and fluid-extract Wood Tar from it. Then distill the Wood Tar to make Benzene. This method produces less pollution, but will also provide less Benzene.

The second path is to use the Pyrolyze Oven multiblock and Nitrogen gas to extract Wood Tar and Charcoal. Fluid-extract the Charcoal for additional Wood Tar. Then proceed as above. This method will create pollution from the Pyrolyze Oven, but will provide more Benzene per log.

Excess wood tar can also be turned into Toluene, a key ingredient for explosives that you'll need later on to make rockets.

If you use the Charcoal Byproducts recipe, you can get a plethora of useful byproducts as well, but you'll need 4 DTs.

[note]Later on you will get an even better option in the form the Industrial Coke Oven.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: Controlling Your Drawers
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you have MV Circuits and Stainless Steel, you can make the incredibly handy Drawer Controller. This block will make any drawers it connects to in a 4-block radius (including the y-axis) and 50 blocks at maximum as part of a multiblock that allows storage (and retrieval with the right setup) to any of the blocks that make it up. This will allow you to dump the contents of your mining trip into a storage system much easier. Just hold right click on the Controller front for a second or two, and any items that match what's already in the multiblock will be deposited, while your tools and such won't. Just make sure to place your Controller last so it registers all the drawers.

You can feed into the Controller (and thus the rest of the drawers) with any kind of piping or hopper equivalent. If using it as part of a Multifarm or Mob Farm, make sure to set the contents of the drawers, and lock them with a key so that it properly stores everything in an organized manner. If the drawers' contents aren't set, it will start filling starting from the ones closest. If you wish to have more than one drawer full of an item, put a void upgrade on the drawer further from the Controller, and it will fill the first one, then the second.

If you want to go around corners, use the Trim Drawers to extend the multiblock. If you want to have a second point to dump items into, use the Controller Slave (one per multiblock, automation only). Note that you can use a key on the Controller to affect all drawers at once.

Once you have an ME Network, place a storage bus on the Controller, and the entire inventory will be accessible from the network, with both storage and retrieval. Just remember to set the priority higher than your ME Drives. If you haven't locked them yet expect all your drawers to fill with random items from your ME Network.

[warn]Using the drawer controller with large amounts of I/O will tank TPS! If you're on a server, do not use drawer cubes, or expect the possibility of it being deleted or you getting banned.

Additionally, expect all non-backpack interactions to be DISABLED on the official servers. Congratulations, Drawer Cubists, you ruined it for everyone.[/warn]
allNodesLists.title: §9§lControlling Your Drawers

When you're mining you'll surely pick up some Meteoric Iron from small ores, enough to make your rocket. But if it's not enough, or you want more, you can also mine the meteors that fall out of the sky.

allNodesLists.data:
An HV Bender is 4x faster than your LV Bender, but it also opens up an important recipe - Tin Cans!

With this bender you can turn Tin Casings into Tin Cans. Using the Tin Cans with food in a Canner will make Canned Food. This can stack up to 64, and will fully restore your shanks - no need to rotate food types any more! You will eat as much as you need with one click. One drawback is you will no longer get the Well Fed buff with its slight health regen bonus, nor will you gain more hearts from eating new food. Also, these cans don't fit in the lunch bag or lunch box so you don't need those any more.

allNodesLists.name: Kinetic Power HV
allNodesLists.data:
The Kinetic Generator will transform mechanical energy into electricity. The EU output depends on the KU input. It is most commonly used together with a Kinetic Wind Generator or Kinetic Water Generator. The Kinetic Steam Generator only has one tier, so your should probably use a Steam Turbine instead.

When placing a kinetic generator, any time, the "input" side is the side facing you. So you will place the kinetic generator, then the wind/water/steam gen, and then place a rotor inside. Power can be drawn from any side of the kinetic generator, up to the rated amount per side.

WARNING: Breaking a kinetic generator improperly will not return the generator. Use a GT wrench, and right-CLICK it. It should drop immediately. Try again if it just changed directions.
allNodesLists.title: §9§lKinetic Power HV

allNodesLists.name: Kinetic Water Power HV
allNodesLists.data:
The Kinetic Water Generator allows Kinetic Units to be produced via the movement of water in river and ocean biomes. As with the Kinetic Wind Generator, it requires either Gearbox Rotor. Search NEI for appropriate options.

If the Kinetic Water Generator's Rotor isn't entirely submerged in water, it will alert you there is "no room for the rotor". If the Kinetic Water Generator isn't placed in a river, ocean or deep ocean biome, it will alert you it "must be placed in a river or ocean biome". Check the Game Mechanics spreadsheet on Discord for a list of biomes and their tags.

While inconvenient, the Water Generator runs more consistently.

[warn]You can use Witchery (for example) to convert biomes.[/warn]
allNodesLists.title: §9§lKinetic Water Power HV
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Kinetic Water Power HV
Prequest requests:
Kinetic Power HV

allNodesLists.name: Kinetic Wind Power HV
allNodesLists.data:
The Kinetic Wind Generator generates energy from wind power which varies randomly, although certain factors can change this.

Unlike the Windmill, the Kinetic Wind Generator will require maintenance in the form of Rotors. These are needed to run the Kinetic Wind Generator.
Once a Rotor is placed inside the GUI, the block is given sufficient space, and the current wind level is adequate for the current rotor, the Kinetic Wind Generator will begin to generate Kinetic Energy.

This can be converted into EU by using a Kinetic Generator attached to the correct face (the black circle).

About Wind
First off, the wind strength of a particular area is affected by 3 factors: Height, Weather, and Chance. The higher up in the world you are, the higher the wind level. Below y64, there is never enough wind to be used, and KWG's will not function at all. Weather will also give boosts; Rainy weather will give a 20% boost to normal wind levels, and stormy weather will give a 50% boost. The final factor of chance makes the wind strength vary randomly, however there is a limited range of variation.

The easiest way to check the current wind level in an area is by using a Windmeter. Wind is strongest at around Y160, towards the build limit of Y255 there is very little wind, hence no point attempting to run Windmills that high. While inconvenient, the Wind Generator can run anywhere.
allNodesLists.title: §9§lKinetic Wind Power HV

allNodesLists.name: Rutile
allNodesLists.data:
You've gotten some Rutile as a byproduct by now, right? Or EBF'd some Ilmenite?

Rutile, Chlorine and Carbon makes Titaniumtetrachloride, and some CO. You can recycle this for Carbon if you want to. Best use a Large Chemical Reactor in that case to get the full recipe.

Combining TiCl4 with Magnesium in an HV EBF will give you a Hot Titanium ingot, and Magnesiumchloride. You can recyle this as well to get all the Magnesium and Chlorine back using some Sodium.

allNodesLists.name: Sending the Power Back
allNodesLists.data:
Kinetic generator compatibility has been improved so that you no longer need transformers, you can connect directly with a cable. But why not use your transformer to send the power back to base more efficiently, it's a loss of about 57/512EU per A just going from 160 straight down to 63 without it. If you transform up (after going through 1 block of cable to transform it to GT power), you only lose about 57/2048EU per A, much better.

[warn]IC2 machines don't care about rain, but remember to cover your transformer.[/warn]

Be sure to check how much gallium you have available. It might not be worth it to use SMD diodes and transistors until you have a steady supply with an HV macerator or bees. Also look into IC2 crops to 4x your zinc, sphalerite, and bauxite.

allNodesLists.name: Some Rare High Tier Metals
allNodesLists.data:
Platinum, Palladium, Iridium and Osmium can be extracted with a chemical reaction from Chalcopyrite and Pentlandite using sulfuric acid. You don't have the technology to process them properly right now but later on you need large amounts of them.

Note that this is not the proper method to get rare metals. This means none of them are pure, and cannot be utilized without the platline method, aside from EBF-ing platinum. Proper Platinum processing is EV, but you'll have to wait until IV to use the rest. Collecting a lot of it now (especially using this method) might not be a great idea depending on how long that will be.

[note]A Chemical Bath also extracts Platinum from Nickel Ore if you use Mercury. Time to head back to the Twilight Forest![/note]

The first one is hydrofluoric acid. If you haven't reached the moon yet, the best sources for fluorine might be cryolite. Other options are treating Sand or Sandstone in a Chemical Plant for some Fluorite Ore, and centrifuging stone dust or black granite dust for biotite. You can also get small amounts from Lepidolite in salt veins and Mica. Mix it with some hydrogen to get hydrofluoric acid.

If you have reached the moon, you can also process Bastnasite ore.

If the broken spawner isn't of the type of mob you want to spawn, you'll need to do some extra work. Capture one in a soul vial, then use that and the broken spawner in the soul binder to change the type. This takes forever, and also levels.

If you set it to capture mode, you can make souls of a specific mob without any danger.

[note]Please try to use as few as possible on servers, mobs are laggy. Use crops if possible.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: UUMatter
allNodesLists.data:
Now you can actually make the UUM with a Mass Fabricator. Well, technically you could make it without UUA, but that's way more expensive. To make sure it only runs with UUA, put a programmed circuit (any value) in the machine's slot. UUMatter can be used for some very specific things, such as replicating §osome§r materials (check NEI, mostly/all periodic table), used with crops to create an ore, some specific high-level recipes need it, and...you can also sit in it to get regen.

The energy usage and overclocking of the Mass Fabricator is different than the usual GT way. To have fixed EU to UUM ratios for all tiers, the machine does perfect 2/2 overclocks. It also start with a very high amperage in LV. The following chart should make it more clear:

Tier Amps EU/t Time
LV 8A 256 160
MV 4A 512 80
HV 2A 1024 40
EV 1A 2048 20
IV 0.5A 4096 10
etc.

Put in power (and hopefully UUA), and out comes UUM. You should also know that you can't use mass fabs or replicators with PAs.

For now, just stockpile the UU matter. You need data orbs to use the replicator, and that's explained next tier.

[note]You only need to complete one of the tasks.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §9§lUUMatter

allNodesLists.data:
Like the chandelier, the magnum torch prevents monsters from spawning. However, its range is quite big, so a single one might be enough for your entire base. The range is 64 blocks horizontally in each direction, and 32 up and down.

[warn]Don't forget, monsters can still follow you home![/warn]

allNodesLists.name: Appropriate Power
allNodesLists.data:
Whether you used magic, steam, oil or biogas for power until now, you will run into problems as you advance to higher tiers. So you'll need to upgrade your power grid, at least for your EBF(s). So let's start with something more powerful: A nuclear reactor!

If you want to know how they work, refer to The Internet or the Reactor Planner at [url]https://github.com/MauveCloud/Ic2ExpReactorPlanner/releases[/url]

Note: The EU multiplier is set to 10x in this pack. That means your nuclear reactor is 10 times more efficient. Make sure to set the planner to GTNH mode under advanced. Also, the base numbers (before 10xing) can be seen on the hover text for all the components.

If you just want to use them, go to [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Nuclear_Reactors[/url] for reactor designs. The Thorium 1920 EU one is probably best for now.
allNodesLists.title: §a§lAppropriate Power

allNodesLists.name: Back to Step 1
allNodesLists.data:
The Refined Platinum Salt can be heated to evaporate the last remaining impurities. Now you are left with PMP again, which you can use back in the first step again.

[note]Add an output hatch to the bottom layer of your EBF to capture the Chlorine for reuse.[/note]
allNodesLists.title: §a§lBack to Step 1
allNodesLists.tooltip:
Back to Step 1

allNodesLists.name: Basic Nuclear Fuel: Thorium
allNodesLists.data:
The weakest of all fuel rods, but very easy to produce, very easy to keep cool and runs twice as long as uranium. It even returns 1/3 of the thorium back later. A perfect "fission and forget" power source.

[warn]Note: After they're used up you can recycle them to get Lutetium which is used for making americium in the fusion reactor. Americium is needed for top tier materials later, so start stockpiling now. Plus, you get power![/warn]
allNodesLists.title: §a§lBasic Nuclear Fuel: Thorium

allNodesLists.name: Bigger Drums
allNodesLists.data:
Now that you have drums, you want them larger? Already??

Well, in that case, you better start collecting or making cobblestone, by the tens of thousands. And making explosives too.

Compress the cobblestone in an assembler first with circuit 1, then run them through the Implosion Compressor until you get Quadruple Compressed Cobblestone. Do that four times, and then another pass through the assembler with a diamond block, and there you have it - one bedrockium ingot.

Now do that 5 more times, and you can make yourself a bedrockium drum.

64k buckets of portable fluid. Perfect for your new Ore drill!

[note]There's also a Bedrockium ore much later on if you're lazy. By then you probably won't want the drums though.[/note]

allNodesLists.data:
Using the scanner, you can scan certain items (check the replicator's NEI recipes) to store the information of the item to a data orb so you can make copies of them with the replicator. This process uses a varying amount of UUM and time, depending on the item. Scanning also takes forever.

Some items you might want to replicate include:
Indium
Platline metals like Iridium and Osmium
Neon, Krypton, Xenon from liquid air distilling
Oganesson

For some things (Oganesson), this might be considered the only reasonable way of getting a decent amount.

allNodesLists.name: Dealing with Radiation
allNodesLists.data:
Nuclear materials cause two types of radiation effects. One is a large number of standard debuffs. These can be removed the normal ways, with milk or terra wart or other methods that imitate them.

The other effect is a special Radiation unique debuff. This gets applied the longer you hold onto the radioactive item. Severely radioactive items can apply minutes of this deadly debuff. Regeneration might delay the inevitable death, but most regeneration sources aren't fast enough or long enough to keep you alive. You can try using an Amulet of Remedium to get rid of the effects. You should have one from your Moon trip, if not you'll have to dive into Thaumcraft to make one.

So how about doubling your doubling to double your double (4x)? Quad rods put out even more power and heat, expect all the other rods to work similarly (for the most part).

allNodesLists.data:
Glass Fiber is used in Fiber Reinforced Boards for circuits. [note]For next tier. Go left for this tier's circuits.[/note]

Borax can be extracted out of Salt ores. Electrolyze it to get Boron and mix it with Glass dust to get Borosilicate Glass Dust.

allNodesLists.data: For IV motors you will need Graphene. Graphene is a material that is just one atom layer thick. It has very favourable electric properties. To create though you will have to make some Graphene you can use a powerful adhesive to pull a single layer of material away from Graphite.

allNodesLists.name: HEV Mark III Protective System
allNodesLists.data:
Some items will give you a Radiation debuff without protection. How long it lasts depends on the item. Some items will give you an enormous or unlimited time debuff timer, which effectively kills you because there's no way to get rid of it.

Other items will give you a general sickness with many debuffs, but not Radiation. That can be removed the normal ways, Milk, Terrawart, Aqua bees, etc.

If you wear a Hazmat suit (and rubber boots!) you are not affected by radioactive effects at all. Same for some other armors that list hazmat protection.

allNodesLists.data:
At EV you're able to make Indium. Indium cannot be found in Ore form [note](except in super small amounts on Ross)[/note].

First you need to make Indium concentrate out of purified galena and sphalerite ore, then mix in some aluminium to get Indium. Indium is used in large amounts later on, automate this ASAP.

You also get lead, zinc, silver, sulfur, and water back from the lead-zinc solution. So it's not like you don't get the materials from the ores at all, just less of them.

allNodesLists.name: Just Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket
allNodesLists.data:
OK, now you can:

1) Turn the Tungsten Trioxide into Hot Tungsten Ingots in the EBF with some Carbon
2) Keep going for TS

We want TS, so put some Hydrogen along with the Tungsten Trioxide in your EBF to get rid of the Oxygen.

Combine your pure Tungsten with Steel in a mixer to get Tungstensteel. Then EBF and then freeze it to get the Tungstensteel ingot.

Some of Tungstensteel Dust you don't need to smelt as you will want to use it for HSS-G!

[note]Note that Tungsten Trioxide to Tungsten Ingot has reduced smelt time. This does not apply to the pure version. You're gonna need a bunch of it in IV as well as the TS, so keep this in mind.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: Power of the Sun from Nuclear
allNodesLists.data:
Your good old singleblock Molecular Transformer is gone. So how to obtain Sunnarium? Well there are couple of ways, but at EV you'll need to radiate Glowstone and convert to Sunnarium.

The Glowstone rod will slowly charge up if you put it next to any fuel rod in your IC2 reactor. The exact charging speed is `(number of rods adjacent) * (floor(hull temperature/3000) + 1)` per second. A dual rod will count as 2 rods and quad fuel rod will count as 4 rods for this purpose. The Glowstone rod will neither emit heat, nor cause other component to emit more heat. You can treat this rod as a reactor plating in the IC2 Reactor Planner.

As you can see, the speed is directly proportional to hull temperature and rods adjacent. At the very extreme you can fully charge up a Glowstone rod in less than half a minute and output one Sunnarium every 10 second (on average, since cells aren't charged at same speed due to different position), but that require very considerable resource to setup. It also involves a vacuum freezer to cooldown the coolant cells and running the reactor at 66000+ hull temperature. Balance your need and your resource situation wisely. In any case, if you just wish to charge it up FAST then here is a possible string for the IC2 Reactor Planner:

erp=bpO50cpsdtJElVqn4hObFJc0tiOE0JpEHYpqTxJHvyezjSKRjUuwgouXzNOlU4a3hFBRygM=

Replace Containment Reactor Plating with actual Glowstone rods and you should be good to go. You can also use fewer reactor chambers by using less plating. Enjoy!

allNodesLists.name: Radon Decay
allNodesLists.data:
Radon is needed for EV Emitters and Sensors.

You can get Radium-226 from sifting Thorium, Pitchblende, Uraninite, or Uranium 238. It needs 4500 seconds, or 75 mins, to decay, and it will debuff you until it decays unless you have complete hazmat protection. It's a good idea to make a Lead-Lined Box and let the Radium decay there, instead.

Thorium can be obtained from the Nether, whereas the other 3 ores are locked after the Tier 2 Rocket. However, Thorium gives a much smaller chance of getting Radium, so you'll need a good amount of it to continue.

After it decays, you can electrolyze Radon out of it and progress into the next circuit line. However, you will not be able to do the Radon loop here, that can only be done with Plutonium 239.

[note]You only need to do one task.[/note]

allNodesLists.name: A Small Reward: The Infinite Spray Can
allNodesLists.data:
Congratulations! You have completed the Platinum Line. Not many players have the perseverance to accomplish this task. A small reward is in order!

The [note]Infinite Spray Can[/note] never runs out of paint, and contains all sixteen colors (as well as solvent!) Of course, line mode and Ring of Loki support are included. There are also many convenience features. Middle click to open a color choice GUI. Middle click a painted block to copy its color to the spray can. Left click to cycle the active color (sneak to go backwards.) Sneak middle click to lock the can; while locked, you can't accidentally change the color. Sneak middle click to unlock.

Naturally, you'll have to craft the infinite spray can yourself. It's a Dire Crafting recipe, so hopefully you have a dire crafting table. It requires a lot of platinum line materials, of course. And, apparently, a rainbow cactus, so a small detour into magic will be necessary. And a bunch of random-looking AE2 parts. And an IV world accelerator. And... a fence?

Is this really a reward?
